svg.text: Spacecraft bus: Structure, avionics and power on the EM and QM, gated by PDR and CDR.
Imaging payload: Optics, detector and payload TVAC; the flight payload is delivered to AIT.
Assembly, integration and test: The FM pre-ship review closes the chain.
FM approval pending system TVAC close-out.
Fast-track starts TVAC 3 wd before calibration ends.
Launch window 22 Oct-5 Nov; missing it means Q1.
Payload TVAC ran 7 days late; margin is now zero.
Ground station done early; link test can move up.
